policies.name: Two gates
policies.desc: Gate 1 decides whether an artifact EXISTS for a viewer (audience). Gate 2 decides which ROWS a viewer sees inside it (data scope). They are administered separately.

policies.name: Counts are computed
policies.desc: Every count on this screen - "sees 939 of 3768" - is derived from the project roster at paint time, never typed.

policies.name: Rule shape
policies.desc: A person is full-scope, or restricted by exactly one basis field plus optional masks.

policies.name: Legal basis
policies.desc: A field qualifies as a restriction basis only if every one of its values is known on every row (utility, region, program, category).

policies.name: Commission view
policies.desc: A filing for a commission carries its own utility’s rate base and evidence; other utilities’ plans and supplier prices stay restricted.

policies.name: Correspondence is runtime
policies.desc: Mailbox content is read at question time under the reader’s permissions and never becomes a graph fact or a cached figure.

policies.name: Provisional forecasts
policies.desc: A forecast older than the monthly refresh is shown as provisional with its date; it is never silently treated as current.

policies.name: Goals act only on approval
policies.desc: A goal drafts notes and lists; anything sent or changed outside the product waits for the person who owns the goal.
